def calculate_segment_profile(segment_data, all_data, segment_id):
    profile = {
        'segment_id': segment_id,
        'segment_size': len(segment_data),
        'segment_percentage': len(segment_data) / len(all_data) * 100
    }

            profile[f'{col}_vs_overall'] = segment_mean - all_mean
            profile[f'{col}_std'] = segment_data[col].std()
            
    return profile
